```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)

# OSM data

OSM <- st_read("week5/greater-london-261111-free.shp/gis_osm_pois_free_1.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700) %>%
  #select hotels only
  filter(fclass == 'hotel')
```

```{r}
# Airbnb data
Airbnb <- read_csv("week5/listings.csv") %>%
  # longitude is considered x value here, latitude is y
  st_as_sf(., coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), 
                   crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(., 27700)%>%
    #select entire places that are available all year
    filter(room_type == 'Entire home/apt' & availability_365 =='365')


#London Borough data is already in 277000
Londonborough <- st_read("week5/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700) %>% 
  clean_names()
```
```{r}
# load world cities
Worldcities <- st_read("week5/World_Cities/World_Cities.shp") %>%
  st_transform(., 27700)
```
```{r}
# filter based on key cities
Worldcities2 <- Worldcities %>%
  filter(CNTRY_NAME=='United Kingdom'&
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='Birmingham'|
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='London'|
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='Edinburgh')

# load UK outline
UK_outline <- st_read("week5/gadm41_GBR_shp/gadm41_GBR_0.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700)
```
```{r}
#Adding normalising data from the Wards 2021/2022 data

#Loading in bedroom 2021 data, setting bedroom column as number type
bedrooms <- read_csv("week5/2021_bedrooms.csv") %>% 
  mutate(bedrooms = parse_number(bedrooms))

#Joining bedroom data to Londonborough data
Londonborough_bedrooms <- Londonborough %>% 
  left_join(., 
            bedrooms,
            by = c("name" = "localauthority")) %>% 
  mutate(bedrooms_by_thousand = (bedrooms / 1000))
```


```{r}
Hotels <-  st_join(Londonborough_bedrooms, OSM)

Airbnbs <-  st_join(Londonborough_bedrooms, Airbnb)

head(Hotels)
```

```{r}
Hotels_sum <- Hotels %>%
  # we need to list the columns we want to keep in the summarise
  group_by(., gss_code, name.x)%>%
  # for each group count the number of rows and store in a column called accommodation count.
  summarise(`Accommodation count` = n())

Airbnb_sum <- Airbnbs %>%
  group_by(., gss_code, name.x)%>%
  summarise(`Accommodation count` = n())
```

```{r}
# the st_join data = 0 Hotels. As of this practical, it's now 1 hotel!
Hotels %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```
```{r}
# the group by and summarise data = 1 Hotel!
Hotels_sum %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```

```{r}
Hotels_example <-st_contains(Londonborough, OSM)

Hotels_example
```

```{r}
Accommodation_contained <- Londonborough_bedrooms %>%
  mutate(hotels_n = lengths(st_contains(., OSM)) / bedrooms_by_thousand )%>%
  mutate(airbnbs_n = lengths(st_contains(., Airbnbs)) / bedrooms_by_thousand )
```

```{r}
Accommodation_contained %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```

```{r}
Hotels2 <- st_join(OSM, Londonborough_bedrooms)
```

```{r}
stats <- Accommodation_contained %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(hotels_n, airbnbs_n) %>%  
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    min = min,
    max = max,
    mean = mean,
    median = median,
    sd = sd
  )))

stats
```

```{r}
library(classInt)

# Get Jenks breaks for 5 classes
breaks <- Accommodation_contained%>%
  st_drop_geometry()%>%
  #need a numeric vector not a dataframe or tibble
  pull(airbnbs_n) %>%             
  classIntervals(., n = 5, style = "jenks")
  
breaks$brks
```
```{r}
tm1 <- tm_shape(Accommodation_contained) +
    tm_polygons(
      fill = c("hotels_n", "airbnbs_n"),
      fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.blues", breaks=breaks$brks),
      # set the legend
      fill.legend = tm_legend(title="Accommodation count",
                              title.size=0.85,
                              size=0.8,
                              # plot outside of the main map
                              #explained below
                              position=tm_pos_out("right", 
                                                  "center",
                                                  pos.v = "center")),
      # all facets share the same legend
      fill.free = FALSE)+
  # make 2 rows for the facets
  tm_facets(nrow=2)

tm1
```
```{r}
  # change headings or remove

tm2 <- tm1+
  tm_layout(panel.labels=c("Hotels per 1000 dwellings", "Airbnb per 1000 dwellings"),
            panel.show = TRUE
            #panel.label.bg.color = "transparent",
            )+
  
  tm_compass(type= "arrow",
            size=1.8, 
            position = tm_pos_out("right", 
                                  "center",
                                  pos.h= -0.05,
                                  pos.v =0.72))+
  tm_scalebar(text.size = 0.7,
              width=10,
              breaks=c(0,10,20),
              position = tm_pos_out("right",
                                    "center", 
                                    pos.h=0.075,
                                    pos.v = 0.68))+
  # we could use tm_credits to place sub-titles like (A) or (B)
  # on the map.
  tm_credits("(c) OpenStreetMap contrbutors and Air b n b",
             size=0.6,
             position = tm_pos_out("center",
                                   "bottom",
                                   pos.v = 1.5,
                                   pos.h=-0.02))

tm2
```

```{r}
newbb <- c(xmin=-296000, ymin=5408, xmax=655696, ymax=1000000)
  
UK_outlinecrop <- UK_outline$geometry %>%
  st_crop(., newbb)
```

```{r}
tm3 <- tm_shape(UK_outlinecrop)+ 
  tm_polygons(col="darkslategray1")+
    tm_layout(frame=FALSE)+
  tm_shape(Worldcities2) +
    #adds the city points
    tm_symbols(shape=20,
               fill = "orange",
               #outline colour
               col="black",
               size=0.8)+
        #add the city labels, x and y move the label around the point
    tm_text("CITY_NAME", xmod=-1, ymod=-0.5)


tm3
```

```{r}
# st_bbox gives the bounding x and y coordinates 
Londonbb <- st_bbox(Accommodation_contained,
                    crs = st_crs(Accommodation_contained))%>%
# st_as_sfc coverts the coordinates to an sfc object
  st_as_sfc()

tm4 <- tm3 +
  tm_shape(Londonbb)+ 
  tm_borders(col = "grey40", lwd = 3)+
    tm_layout(frame=FALSE,
            bg.color = "transparent")

tm4
```

```{r}
inset <- tmap_grob(tm4, asp=1.1)

final_map<- tm2+
  tm_inset(inset,
             position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"))
tmap_save(final_map, "week5/2_facet.png", width = 8, height = 6, units="in", dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

accom_long <- Accommodation_contained %>%
  # drop geometry for plotting
  st_drop_geometry() %>%  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(hotels_n, airbnbs_n),
    names_to = "accom_type",
    values_to = "count"
  )
```

```{r}
violin <- accom_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = accom_type, 
             # number
             y = count, 
             # hotels or airbnb 
             fill = accom_type)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, 
              color = "grey30", 
              alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "black"
  ) +
  # change the labels from the column names to..
scale_x_discrete(labels = c("hotels_n" = "Hotels", 
                            "airbnbs_n" = "Airbnbs"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  theme(
    # no legend
    legend.position = "none",
    # all text to black
    text = element_text(color = "black"),         # set all text to black
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),    # axis tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),   # axis titles (if used)
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black")    # title (if used)
  )
```
